name: agent-vault
description: External-brain skills and quiet hooks over project-owned OKF bundles with SQLite task concepts.

interface.shortDescription: Use a project-owned OKF bundle as memory.
interface.longDescription: Agent Vault gives Codex durable project memory through independently bootstrapped OKF bundles under ~/agent-vault (overridable via AGENT_VAULT), SQLite-backed task concepts, and quiet lifecycle hooks that orient sessions, link commits, preserve pre-compaction state, and capture root-thread teardown.
